entities.summary: Execuflight Flight 1526 was a domestic charter flight flying from Dayton–Wright Brothers Airport to Akron Executive Airport in Ohio. On November 10, 2015, while on approach into Akron, the crew unknowingly let the airspeed of the aircraft decrease until it stalled and crashed into a building. There were no casualties on the ground, but the 9 occupants were killed.
